headword: {台所仕事|だいどころしごと}

definitions.gloss: kitchen work; cooking and kitchen chores
definitions.explanation: Work done in the kitchen, including cooking, washing dishes, cleaning, and food preparation. Refers to the everyday domestic labor of meal-related tasks.

examples.japanese: {台所仕事|だいどころしごと}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧だ。
examples.english: Kitchen work is tough every day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{台所仕事|だいどころしごと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}われている→追う：02016_ou⟧。
examples.english: My mother has been busy with kitchen work since morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{共働|ともばたら}き→共働き：08564_tomobataraki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{台所仕事|だいどころしごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{夫婦|ふうふ}→夫婦：03592_fuufu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{分担|ぶんたん}→分担：11771_buntan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当|あ}たり{前|まえ}→当たり前：01685_atarimae⟧になってきた。
examples.english: In dual-income households, it has become normal for couples to share kitchen duties.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{台所|だいどころ}→台所：01021_daidokoro⟧ (kitchen) and ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧ (work, task). A compound noun referring to the full range of kitchen-related domestic labor. Has a slightly traditional or homey feel compared to more modern terms like ⟦{家事|かじ}→家事：12313_kaji⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {台所仕事|だいどころしごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do kitchen work
- {台所仕事|だいどころしごと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}われる→追う：02016_ou⟧: to be chased by kitchen duties
- {台所仕事|だいどころしごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手伝|てつだ}う→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧: to help with kitchen work
- {台所仕事|だいどころしごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分担|ぶんたん}→分担：11771_buntan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to share kitchen duties

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{家事|かじ}→家事：12313_kaji⟧: housework — broader term covering all domestic chores, not just kitchen-related ones
- ⟦{炊事|すいじ}→炊事：00385_suiji⟧: cooking — focuses specifically on the act of cooking meals, not cleaning or preparation
- ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧: cooking, cuisine — the act of preparing food, more focused on the creative/skill aspect
- {水仕事|みずしごと}: water work — kitchen and laundry tasks involving water; often used when discussing chapped hands in winter
